value.rationale: Egalitarian and sex-equal matching are standard but genuinely different fairness goals. The smallest market where they force incompatible stable choices is a natural finite boundary, and the complete joint census is substantially more informative than an isolated witness or a one-objective table.
residual_risks: An unindexed thesis, exercise, software table or supplementary computation may contain the same finite classification.

final_claim: For complete strict stable marriage, egalitarian and sex-equal optimum sets coincide for every two-pair profile; for three pairs their exact relation counts over all 46656 labeled profiles are 40056 equal, 3720 with the sex-equal set strictly contained in the egalitarian set, 360 with the reverse strict containment, and 2520 disjoint, with no nonnested nonempty overlap.
limitations: Complete strict balanced stable marriage with at most three pairs only.
No general larger-market frequency or structural theorem is claimed.
